qt: to the Commission Emmanouil Kefalogiannis (PPE) Subject:

The Mediterranean diet is a recognised element of UNESCO’s intangible cultural heritage and a model of healthy eating, with significant benefits for public health, sustainable agriculture and the agri-food economy. The Greek initiative ‘Rebranding the Mediterranean Way of Living and Generation Z’ aims to reconnect the young generation with the Mediterranean diet and lifestyle, using education, innovation and youth entrepreneurship. The initiative has already been brought to the attention of the Commission and the competent Directorate-General for the Middle East, North Africa and the Gulf (DG MENA), with a view to its integration into the Pact for the Mediterranean Action Plan, in particular through the Mediterranean University. In view of the above: 1.
Does the Commission intend to support the inclusion of this initiative in the second edition of the Pact for the Mediterranean Action Plan?
What specific financial tools and institutional mechanisms does the Commission intend to use to implement it?
How will the Commission ensure the participation of Greek universities, research institutions and agri-food bodies, while strengthening the cooperation of the young people of the Mediterranean?
